title: Scenario loader: data/demo/tiny into contract models via app.data.load.load_scenario, plus a validate_plan stub with the final signature
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_load.py -q

title: Contract tests: tiny scenario and every data/demo/tiny/expected/*.json round-trip through the models, and expected scenario_hash values match the loader
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/contract/test_fixtures_roundtrip.py -q

title: Boundary test: app/validate never imports app.planning or app.baselines, app/contracts imports no lane code
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/contract/test_boundaries.py -q

title: Validator recomputes capacity, cluster, skill, readiness, deadline, inventory, and locks from assignments and sets checked=true
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_validator.py -q

title: Validator passes every expected tiny plan with zero issues and flags one deliberately broken plan per ViolationCode
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_validator.py -q -k "expected or broken"

title: Validator recomputes ObjectiveComponents and flags OBJECTIVE_MISMATCH
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_validator.py -q -k objective

title: Tiny enumerator reproduces expected objectives for strict, strict infeasible, and recovery with Crew A out Monday
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_enumerate_tiny.py -q

title: Input validation returns structured InputIssues for duplicate IDs, unknown references, bad values, date order, duplicate planned installs
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_validate_inputs.py -q

title: Ready date after deadline loads as a valid scenario. Contradictory hard locks surface as CONTRADICTORY_LOCKS and are never dropped
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_validate_inputs.py -q -k "ready_after_deadline or contradictory_locks"

title: Synthetic standard scenario: 30 jobs, 3 clusters, 3 crews, 10 working days, fixed seed, labeled synthetic, byte-identical reruns, loads through load_scenario
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_generate_standard.py -q

title: Manifest writer: source URL, release, retrieval date, covered dates, license, sha256, transformation, row count, field kinds
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_manifest.py -q

title: ERCOT NP6-785-ER 2018 load-zone prices to prices.parquet in UTC, interval-ending and DST handled, no filled gaps, manifest written
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_prepare_ercot.py -q && test -f ../data/manifests/ercot_np6_785_2018.json

title: Battery MILP: energy conservation and boundary energy equal to reserve
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_battery.py -q -k "conservation or boundary"

title: Battery MILP: power limits, no simultaneous charge and discharge, negative prices
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_battery.py -q -k "limits or simultaneous or negative"

title: Value table value(site_id, install_date) with solver status per row. Identical sites in one zone get identical same-date values
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_value_table.py -q

title: Value table cached by input hash under data/cache. A second call runs no solves
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_value_table.py -q -k cache

title: HCAD bounded GeoJSON query to a standard_real scenario, anonymized IDs, no owner names or addresses, manifest written
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_prepare_hcad.py -q && test -f ../data/manifests/hcad_parcels.json

title: Load-limited valuation sensitivity with ResStock profiles, labeled modeled
acceptance: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/lane_a/test_battery.py -q -k load_limited
